meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为系统化的证据驱动步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂任务拆解为可执行的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Decompose work into systematic, evidence-driven steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex tasks into actionable steps

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“超工作模式”将复杂任务分解为系统化的、有证据约束的步骤，并持续执行直到完成。它会使用专门的 CLI 工具管理状态，记录每一步的证据，并可以调用子代理处理代码编辑、测试等工作。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”、持久目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动 QA 或带检查点的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop，分解当前任务。
say.note: Claude 会读取工作流文件并开始执行。

say.text: 使用 ulw 模式处理这个长期项目。
say.note: Claude 会进入证据驱动的循环执行。

say.text: 执行 ulw-loop，并记录每一步的证据。
say.note: Claude 会创建目标并跟踪进度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude decomposes complex tasks into systematic, evidence-bound steps using ultrawork mode, and executes them persistently. It manages state via a CLI tool, records evidence for each step, and can delegate code edits, tests, and QA to subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop and decompose the current task.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow file and begins execution.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode for this long-term project.
Run ulw-loop and record evidence for each step.
say_en.note: Claude creates goals and tracks progress.
